message: New P1 in Reviewer1 frozen follow-up d85fbf4ca24749d188d46c77106f5794 = ChangesRequested. Your fix preserved fresh poll-time STOP alongside completed ToolResponse correctly, but a different path consumes alert during background completion of promoted tool job; original ToolResponse.Instructions holds the STOP and every subsequent get_job_result replays it (one-shot violation). Worse, if completed job is never polled, STOP is stranded and not delivered on next unrelated agent response. See findings/promoted-job-alert-replay.md. Make alert consumption occur at actual agent-visible response boundary only (never background completion), preserve original completion evidence and poll-time merged instructions, no duplication/replay. Test repeated poll and unpolled completion + unrelated tool. Implement minimum scope, .NET11 Release, NEW frozen independent review, no deployment.
